source_commits.subject: fix(types): record builtin provenance at declaration sites (T1693)

root_cause: register_primitives and register_builtins union-snapshotted every type/environment name. Metadata or source declarations already loaded before a registration pass thereby acquired builtin provenance, suppressing an explicit missing-import error.
repair: Record provenance at each actual builtin type/value declaration through two helpers, then call the same context registration operation. All primitive, intrinsic, meta-type and meta-function registration sites participate, including monomorphic values. Remove the populated-environment snapshot; process_import and its genuine-builtin compatibility rule are unchanged.
causal_boundary: Metadata controls exercise new_with_core_eager and lazy construction, both descriptor orders, primitive/full registration, and repeated passes after actual type loading. Their causal failure concerns Parcel; metadata free-function names alone are not proof those values were installed by the eager constructor.
Parsed source type and value declarations independently reproduce incorrect Parcel and published_fn builtin provenance after a later registration pass.
Missing-import controls call process_import directly and require ImportModuleNotFound or ImportItemNotFound. A downstream body/type error cannot satisfy the refusal oracle.
Real primitive, intrinsic and meta builtin exemptions survive repeated registration. Re-registering a real builtin still overwrites its previous type/scheme, preserving existing behavior.
The unchanged T1692 missing-export oracle now passes. The earlier T1692 field-owner repair and actual archive evidence remain separately attributed in registry-record-field-owner-gate.json.
No new ignore, import fallback, source/module exception, hardcoded builtin-name catalogue or metadata lookup policy was introduced.
ordinary_boundary: These source-library gates run with automatic precompilation disabled. They do not establish ordinary CLI, standard-library rebake, registry project/runtime, AOT or service acceptance.
